usermerge-desc: [[Special:UserMerge|Waxay tixraacyada hal isticmaale ugu gudbisaa isticmaale kale]] ee ku jira kaydka xogta wiki-ga — sidoo kale waxay tirtirtaa isticmaalayaashii hore marka isku-darka la dhammeeyo. Waxay u baahan tahay mudnaanta ''usermerge''
usermerge-badnewuser: Magaca cusub ee isticmaalaha ma saxna.
usermerge-badolduser: Magaca hore ee isticmaalaha ma saxna.
usermerge-nonewuser:
Magaca cusub ee isticmaalaha waa madhan. Waxaa loo qaadanayaa in lagu darayo "{{GENDER:$1|$1}}".
Guji "{{int:usermerge-submit}}" si aad u aqbasho.
usermerge-noolduser: Magaca hore ee isticmaalaha waa madhan.
usermerge-same-old-and-new-user: Magacyada hore iyo kuwa cusub ee isticmaalayaashu waa inay kala duwanaadaan.
usermerge-badtoken: Calaamadda wax ka beddelka ma saxna.
usermerge-success: Isku darka $1 ($2) iyo $3 ($4) waa la dhammaystiray.
usermerge-logpagetext: Kani waa diiwaanka ficillada isku darka isticmaalayaasha.
usermerge-noselfdelete: Ma tirtiri kartid ama iskuma dari kartid {{GENDER:$1|naftaada}}!
usermerge-protectedgroup: Lama isku dari karo {{GENDER:$1|isticmaalaha}}: isticmaaluhu wuxuu ku jiraa koox la ilaaliyo.
usermerge-autopagedelete: Bogga si otomaatig ah ayaa loo tirtiray intii isticmaalayaasha la isku darayay
usermerge-move-log: Bogga si otomaatig ah ayaa loo wareejiyay intii akoonka "$1" lagu darayay "[[User:$2|$2]]"
